title: Edit Inventory Part lists its fields in the set order
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • Active, tracked part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-ORDER-01) is stocked at {Location-A}.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Parts → Inventory and type {Part-A} in the search.
  2. Click the {Part-A} row.
  3. Scroll the window from top to bottom.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: the fields appear in this order: Description, Part Number, Part Status (Active / Inactive), Vendor, Category, Manufacturer, Average Cost, Sell Price, Core Charge, Inventory Tracking (the switch "Track quantities and cost of goods", then Min and Max), Tags, and Inventory (the bin rows, then "Add Bin Location").
  • Step 3: "Add Bin Location" has a plus icon before its label.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S13-R4, S13-R5, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 2.1 (The part as it stands), board 3.1 (Part Status in the dialog), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S13-R4: “The fields appear in this order: Description, Part Number, Part Status (editing only), Vendor, Category, Manufacturer, Average Cost (editing) or Cost (creating), Sell Price, Core Charge, Inventory Tracking (the switch, then Min and Max), Tags, and Inventory (bin locations, then "Add Bin Location").”
  • S13-R5: “"Add Bin Location" has a plus icon before its label.”
